summary:
Project Summary
Our project, "Space Mission: Design Your Universe," is an interactive educational game that allows players to create, plan, and simulate their own space missions. Players take on the role of space engineers and must choose a destination, select a spacecraft, add scientific instruments, and manage energy, communication systems, and a limited budget.
The game addresses the challenge of understanding how real space missions are designed by allowing participants to make engineering decisions and experience how each choice affects the mission's success. Players must balance resources, solve problems, and make strategic decisions to complete their objectives.
This project is important because it makes learning about space exploration, science, and engineering more interactive, practical, and entertaining. It also encourages creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and responsible resource management.
details:
The project was developed using digital design and presentation tools, including Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Docs, with support from ChatGPT for developing the game concept, organizing its content, and preparing the interactive prototype. No specific programming language or physical hardware was used in this initial prototype.

How is the project creative and innovative?

The creativity of our project comes from combining space exploration with an interactive gaming experience. Instead of simply reading about space missions, players can make their own engineering decisions, choose different spacecraft components, manage resources, and discover how their choices affect the mission. This makes learning more engaging and practical.

What factors did our team consider?

Our team considered several important factors when designing the project, including mission objectives, spacecraft selection, scientific instruments, launch requirements, available budget, energy consumption, spacecraft mass, communication systems, and orbital limitations. We also considered the importance of making the game easy to understand, educational, interactive, and enjoyable for different participants.

Our main purpose is to demonstrate that designing a successful space mission requires planning, creativity, teamwork, and responsible resource management. Through this game, we hope to bring the challenges of space engineering closer to students in a fun and educational way.
